exposure: gestational anemia (Hb < 110 g/l in third trimester)
cohort: 1238 women who participated in the FinnBrain Birth Cohort during 2011-2015 and had available hemoglobin levels in the third trimester.
finding: Gestational anemia in the third trimester was not associated with the duration and quality of breastfeeding after adjusting for confounding factors.
followup_time: Up to 10 months postpartum (for breastfeeding duration)
